purpose: Scale the feasibility-only BookStack evidence into a stratified empirical-study collection without pooling incomparable pilot artifacts.

current_evidence.interpretation: BookStack-only feasibility/admission subgates; records remain separated by workflow, condition, configuration, and run tag

near_term_panels.purpose: Reference-family coverage on the three already provisioned SUTs.
gates: fault positive and clean negative control

near_term_panels.purpose: Separate model/framework/tooling effects from the reference-family comparison.
required_coverage: second provider/model for visual and hybrid

near_term_panels.purpose: Estimate within-cell instability and provider drift separately from cross-task effects.

non_substitution_rules: Do not replace missing SUTs or workflows with more repetitions of bookstack-open-book.
Do not pool different provider/model, framework, run-tag, protocol, task, or condition strata.
Do not count adapter conformance, connectivity checks, diagnostics, or oracle-only success as confirmatory runs.
Unknown token or billed cost remains null and is not imputed as zero.
